utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning all, happy Friday. You alright? Let's get cracking, quick stand-up before everyone disappears onto the floor.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Morning. Bit rough after the football last night, not gonna lie.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, don't start. Absolute robbery, that.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I turned it off, mate. Better for the blood pressure.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, save VAR for later. Safety, production, maintenance, then actions. Grace, you go.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, cheers. Safety-wise nothing major. I tested the long belt yesterday and it's all fine now, so that's closed out, not one for today.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Only blocker from me, we're still waiting on parts for the turbine one compressor, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, noted, blocked not active. Anything else?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No, that's me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one. Fiona?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Morning. Planning side, tested the line 1 hydraulics yesterday and it's all fine now, so again that's done, no follow-up needed today.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Schedules are mostly alright, just a bit tight this afternoon if line 2 slips.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Ash?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah so, process side okay-ish. I did hear a slight rattle from the 11kV board, nothing to action yet, just clocking it in case it gets worse.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Mm, keep an ear on it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, observation only for now. Olu, how're you?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: All good. Bit humid already. If this weather keeps up I'll be welding myself to a panel by lunch.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Weekend plans sorted then, just stand in front of a fan and complain?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: That's basically it, yeah. Maybe barbecue if it doesn't chuck it down, because obviously the forecast can't make its mind up.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Very good. Back in the room. Callum?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Production's stable enough. Atlas is still the same story, still waiting on parts for the Atlas, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, blocked. Not for today then.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Other than that, changeover was a bit messy but we got through it.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Whose new car is that in the car park by the way? White electric thing. Looks far too clean for this place.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Not mine, mine's held together with zip ties and hope.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Thought it was a visitor at first. If it's one of ours it'll have dust on it by dinner.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Top Gear later. Priya, anything urgent from electrical?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Nothing screaming. Couple of nuisance trips overnight but they've reset cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, good. I've got a few actions we need to pin down. First one, Ash, can you run the monthly fire alarm test? It needs doing this week, ideally tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, Ash can do that. I'll run the monthly fire alarm test tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Give me a shout when you do it and I'll make sure the wardens know, but yeah that's fine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one, that's agreed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Next, Olu, the palletiser's still being a pain. Can you clear the jam and check the sensors on the palletiser? Top priority please, and I need that on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, alright. I'll get onto the palletiser and clear the jam and check the sensors on the palletiser.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: On the 3rd is fine. If it's just product build-up it'll be quick, if a sensor bracket's bent I might need a bit longer, but I'll cover it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine, but top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, understood, top priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers. Anything else from maintenance side while we're there?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Actually, I'll replace the seals on the BFP by 11am. Better I just grab that myself before the shift gets away from us.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: You're happy taking that, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll replace the seals on the BFP by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Good shout, that one's been weeping a bit.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Sorted. And Callum, separate one, can you sort the training records for the new starters? No rush, but I do want that by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah alright, Callum can do that. I'll sort the training records for the new starters by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Ta. No rush, just want it cleaned up before audit prep.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, understood.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Priya, one for you as well, if you've got a spare minute, can you organise the toolbox talk for the team?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, Priya can do that. I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Can you swing it around manual isolation, maybe? Keep it practical.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, happy to. I'll keep it short so nobody falls asleep.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Too late for me, to be fair.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That'd be a first. Right, anything likely to trip us up today that we haven't said?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Only dispatch timing, but that's not an action, just a heads-up. If the afternoon wagon's early we'll be juggling.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, noted.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: On the fire alarm test, I'll do the usual route and radio through as I go.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Perfect, just because of the contractors near blending, they jump out their skin every time.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, fair.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: For the palletiser, I might isolate the infeed for a bit while I clear it, so just tell ops not to keep lobbing product at me.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: We've tried shouting, doesn't always work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll brief the line leads. But yes, Olu's on the palletiser, leave him space.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: If you find the sensor's actually gone, give me a bell and I'll help with the wiring side.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, cheers.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anything from HSE beyond the compressor parts delay?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No, that's it. And just to be clear, the turbine one compressor stays blocked till the bits turn up, so nobody's chasing that today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, understood.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Same with the Atlas from me, before anyone asks. Still waiting on parts for the Atlas, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I've got both of those flagged in the plan anyway.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good stuff.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: What colour was that car actually? White or that weird pearl thing?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Here we go again.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Priya's more interested in that than the nuisance trips.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No, no, I can multitask. Barely.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this fully derails: recap. Ash on the monthly fire alarm test tomorrow morning, needs doing this week. Olu on the palletiser, top priority please, on the 3rd. Callum replacing the seals on the BFP by 11am and sorting the training records for the new starters by Wednesday, no rush. Priya organising the toolbox talk for the team if you've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, got it.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: All good.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, fine.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Sounds good.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I'll update the board after this.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Brilliant. Stay safe, shout if anything changes, and try not to melt out there.
